finding.headline: "The Existential-Loneliness Mum"
finding.problem: "People ask about the baby, never about me. I can't remember who I was before. I feel like a machine, not a woman."
finding.person: Mum who feels "forgotten as a person, existing only as a mother" — the existential dimension the Finland study says standard screening misses (Psychreg/Åbo Akademi).
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Remember Me: Reclaiming the Woman Behind the Mother."". Verdict: PASSES.
